from pathlib import Path
import re
root = Path('docs/tasks/2026-10-19-harness-tools')
paths = [root/'task.md', root/'drafts/workspace-agent/harness/tools/design.md', root/'drafts/workspace-agent/harness/tools/impl.md', root/'drafts/workspace-agent/harness/tools/bash/design.md']
for path in paths:
    text = path.read_text()
    assert text.strip(), path
    if path.name != 'task.md':
        assert text.startswith('<!-- Task proposal; current contract is under docs/systems/ -->'), path
    assert not any(line.rstrip() != line for line in text.splitlines()), path
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', text):
        if '://' not in target:
            assert (path.parent/target.split('#')[0]).exists(), (path, target)
bash = paths[-1].read_text()
for block in re.findall(r'<metadata>\n(.*?)\n</metadata>', bash, re.S):
    assert not any(re.match(r'\s*'+field+r'\s*:', line) for line in block.splitlines() for field in ['cwd','cwd_before','cwd_after','pid','output_path']), block
for phrase in ['command: string', 'cwd?: string', 'timeout?: number', 'background?: boolean', 'metadata?:', 'job_id: 1', '/dev/null', 'Remaining decisions']:
    assert phrase in bash, phrase
print('PASS: proposal markers, local links, whitespace, Bash input and metadata examples.')
